final: WITH line_totals AS (SELECT b.budget_id, COALESCE(SUM(e.cost), 0) AS total_cost, COUNT(e.expense_id) AS expense_count FROM budget AS b LEFT JOIN expense AS e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id GROUP BY b.budget_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS average_total FROM line_totals) SELECT AVG(l.total_cost) AS average_above_average_total, SUM(l.expense_count) AS total_expenses, AVG(l.total_cost - o.average_total) AS average_excess FROM line_totals AS l CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE l.total_cost > o.average_total
